Class PatchComponentSitesGraph.SiteNode

java.lang.Object

arcade.patch.env.component.PatchComponentSitesGraph.SiteNode
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public static class PatchComponentSitesGraph.SiteNode extends Graph.Node
Extension of Graph.Node for site nodes.

Node tracks additional hemodynamic properties including pressure and oxygen.
